defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter do
  @moduledoc """
  A tiny global invocation counter.

  It is deliberately process independent so that a counter bumped inside a data
  loading callback can be observed from anywhere in the VM.

  DO NOT MODIFY THIS MODULE.
  """

  @key {__MODULE__, :counts}

  @doc "Clears every counter."
  @spec reset() :: :ok
  def reset do
    :persistent_term.put(@key, %{})
    :ok
  end

  @doc "Increments the counter stored under `key`."
  @spec bump(atom()) :: :ok
  def bump(key) when is_atom(key) do
    counts = :persistent_term.get(@key, %{})
    :persistent_term.put(@key, Map.update(counts, key, 1, &(&1 + 1)))
    :ok
  end

  @doc "Returns the current value of the counter stored under `key`."
  @spec count(atom()) :: non_neg_integer()
  def count(key) when is_atom(key), do: Map.get(counts(), key, 0)

  @doc "Returns every counter as a map."
  @spec counts() :: %{optional(atom()) => non_neg_integer()}
  def counts, do: :persistent_term.get(@key, %{})
end

  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements) || 0

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    endorsements =
      Enum.filter(all_links, &(&1.kind == :follow_up))
      |> Enum.frequencies_by(& &1.to_message_id)

    by_thread_id = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.thread_id})
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    board_map = Enum.into(threads, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.board})

    all_messages_with_end =
      Enum.map(all_messages, fn m ->
        endors = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
        t_id = Map.get(by_thread_id, m.id)
        board = Map.get(board_map, t_id)
        {m, endors, board}
      end)

    # Apply filter

      Enum.filter(all_messages_with_end, fn {m, endors, board} ->
        board in boards and endors >= min_endorsements
      end)

    # filter. Let me check if the query filter should be applied. The requirement says: "a filter
    # carried by the incoming query must be honoured".)

      Enum.filter(filtered, fn {m, _, _} ->
        Ash.Query.filter_satisfied?(m, query.filter)
      end)

    # Ordering
    sorted =
      case Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        true ->
          Enum.sort_by(filtered2, fn {m, endors, _} ->
            {-endors, m.position, m.id}
          end)

        false ->
          # Apply query sort
          Enum.sort(filtered2, fn {ma, endsa, _}, {mb, endsb, _} ->
            Ash.Sort.compare(ma, mb, query.sort, :message) != :gt
          end)
      end

    # Limit/offset

      sorted
      |> Enum.drop(query.offset || 0)
      |> then(fn s ->
        case query.limit do
          nil -> s
          l -> Enum.take(s, l)
        end
      end)

    results =
      Enum.map(limited, fn {m, endors, _} ->
        Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, endors)
      end)

    {:ok, results}
  end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.LinkedMessages do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship
  require Ash.Query

  def load(messages, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:linked_messages)

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    adj = Enum.group_by(all_links, & &1.from_message_id, & &1.to_message_id)
    message_map = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1})

    {:ok,
     Enum.map(messages, fn message ->
       bfs(message.id, adj, message_map)
     end)}
  end

  defp bfs(source_id, adj, message_map) do
    {dists, _} = bfs_loop(:queue.from_list([{source_id, 0}]), %{}, MapSet.new([source_id]), adj)

    dists
    |> Map.delete(source_id)
    |> Enum.map(fn {id, dist} ->
      message = Map.fetch!(message_map, id)
      {dist, message.position, message.id, message}
    end)
    |> Enum.sort()
    |> Enum.map(fn {_, _, _, message} -> message end)
  end

  defp bfs_loop(queue, dists, visited, adj) do
    case :queue.out(queue) do
      {:empty, _q} -> {dists, visited}
      {{:value, {id, dist}}, q} ->
        neighbors = Map.get(adj, id, [])
        {q2, d2, v2} = Enum.reduce(neighbors, {q, dists, visited}, fn neighbor, {acc_q, acc_dists, acc_visited} ->
          if MapSet.member?(acc_visited, neighbor) do
            {acc_q, acc_dists, acc_visited}
          else
            { :queue.in({neighbor, dist + 1}, acc_q),
              Map.put(acc_dists, neighbor, dist + 1),
              MapSet.put(acc_visited, neighbor)
            }
          end
        end)
        bfs_loop(q2, d2, v2, adj)
    end
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements) || 0

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    endorsements =
      Enum.filter(all_links, &(&1.kind == :follow_up))
      |> Enum.frequencies_by(& &1.to_message_id)

    by_thread_id = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.thread_id})
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    board_map = Enum.into(threads, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.board})

    all_messages_with_end =
      Enum.map(all_messages, fn m ->
        endors = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
        t_id = Map.get(by_thread_id, m.id)
        board = Map.get(board_map, t_id)
        {m, endors, board}
      end)

    # Apply filter
    filtered =
      Enum.filter(all_messages_with_end, fn {_m, endors, board} ->
        board in boards and endors >= min_endorsements
      end)

    # Apply the query's own filter on top
    filtered2 =
      Enum.filter(filtered, fn {m, _, _} ->
        Ash.Query.filter_satisfied?(m, query.filter)
      end)

    # Ordering
    sorted =
      case Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        true ->
          Enum.sort_by(filtered2, fn {m, endors, _} ->
            {-endors, m.position, m.id}
          end)

        false ->
          # Apply query sort
          Enum.sort(filtered2, fn {ma, endsa, _}, {mb, endsb, _} ->
            Ash.Sort.compare(ma, mb, query.sort, :message) != :gt
          end)
      end

    # Limit/offset
    limited =
      sorted
      |> Enum.drop(query.offset || 0)
      |> then(fn s ->
        case query.limit do
          nil -> s
          l -> Enum.take(s, l)
        end
      end)

    # Set metadata
    results =
      Enum.map(limited, fn {m, endors, _} ->
        Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, endors)
      end)

    {:ok, results}
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements) || 0

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    endorsements =
      Enum.filter(all_links, &(&1.kind == :follow_up))
      |> Enum.frequencies_by(& &1.to_message_id)

    by_thread_id = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.thread_id})
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    board_map = Enum.into(threads, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.board})

    all_messages_with_end =
      Enum.map(all_messages, fn m ->
        endors = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
        t_id = Map.get(by_thread_id, m.id)
        board = Map.get(board_map, t_id)
        {m, endors, board}
      end)

    # Apply filter
    filtered =
      Enum.filter(all_messages_with_end, fn {_m, endors, board} ->
        board in boards and endors >= min_endorsements
      end)

    # Apply the query's own filter on top
    filtered2 =
      Enum.filter(filtered, fn {m, _, _} ->
        Ash.Query.filter_satisfied?(m, query.filter)
      end)

    # Ordering
    sorted =
      case Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        true ->
          Enum.sort_by(filtered2, fn {m, endors, _} ->
            {-endors, m.position, m.id}
          end)

        false ->
          # Apply query sort
          Enum.sort(filtered2, fn {ma, _endsa, _}, {mb, _endsb, _} ->
            Ash.Sort.compare(ma, mb, query.sort, :message) != :gt
          end)
      end

    # Limit/offset
    limited =
      sorted
      |> Enum.drop(query.offset || 0)
      |> then(fn s ->
        case query.limit do
          nil -> s
          l -> Enum.take(s, l)
        end
      end)

    # Set metadata
    results =
      Enum.map(limited, fn {m, endors, _} ->
        Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, endors)
      end)

    {:ok, results}
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements) || 0

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    endorsements =
      Enum.filter(all_links, &(&1.kind == :follow_up))
      |> Enum.frequencies_by(& &1.to_message_id)

    by_thread_id = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.thread_id})
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    board_map = Enum.into(threads, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.board})

    all_messages_with_end =
      Enum.map(all_messages, fn m ->
        endors = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
        t_id = Map.get(by_thread_id, m.id)
        board = Map.get(board_map, t_id)
        {m, endors, board}
      end)

    # Apply filter
    filtered =
      Enum.filter(all_messages_with_end, fn {_m, endors, board} ->
        board in boards and endors >= min_endorsements
      end)

    # Apply the query's own filter on top
    filtered2 =
      Enum.filter(filtered, fn {m, _endors, _board} ->
        Ash.Filter.matches?(m, query.filter)
      end)

    # Ordering
    sorted =
      case Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        true ->
          Enum.sort_by(filtered2, fn {m, endors, _} ->
            {-endors, m.position, m.id}
          end)

        false ->
          # Apply query sort
          Enum.sort(filtered2, fn {ma, _endsa, _}, {mb, _endsb, _} ->
            Ash.Sort.compare(ma, mb, query.sort) != :gt
          end)
      end

    # Limit/offset
    limited =
      sorted
      |> Enum.drop(query.offset || 0)
      |> then(fn s ->
        case query.limit do
          nil -> s
          l -> Enum.take(s, l)
        end
      end)

    # Set metadata
    results =
      Enum.map(limited, fn {m, endors, _} ->
        Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, endors)
      end)

    {:ok, results}
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Threads.ForkThread do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualCreate
  require Ash.Query

  def create(changeset, _opts, context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:fork)

    source_message_id = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :source_message_id)
    slug = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :slug)
    title = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :title)

    source_message =
      ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
      |> Ash.Query.filter(id == ^source_message_id)
      |> Ash.Query.load(:thread)
      |> Ash.read_one(domain: context.domain)

    case source_message do
      nil ->
        {:error,
         %Ash.Error.Invalid{
           errors: [
             %Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument{
               field: :source_message_id,
               message: "source message not found"
             }
           ]
         }}

      %{thread: %{locked: true}} ->
        {:error,
         %Ash.Error.Invalid{
           errors: [
             %Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument{
               field: :source_message_id,
               message: "source thread is locked"
             }
           ]
         }}

      source_message ->
        # Use a transaction so nothing gets created on failure
        Ash.Domain.transaction(context.domain, fn ->
          all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: context.domain)
          descendants = get_all_descendants(source_message, all_messages)

          new_thread =
            ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread
            |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
              slug: slug,
              title: title,
              board: source_message.thread.board,
              locked: false
            })
            |> Ash.create!(domain: context.domain)

          sorted_originals = Enum.sort_by(descendants, fn m -> {m.position, m.id} end)
          original_to_copy = %{}

          {new_messages, _final_map} =
            Enum.reduce(sorted_originals, {[], original_to_copy}, fn m, {acc, map} ->
              new_parent_id =
                cond do
                  m.id == source_message.id -> nil
                  true -> Map.fetch!(map, m.parent_id)
                end

              new_position = map_size(map) + 1

              copy =
                ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
                |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
                  body: m.body,
                  score: m.score,
                  author_id: m.author_id,
                  parent_id: new_parent_id,
                  thread_id: new_thread.id,
                  position: new_position
                })
                |> Ash.create!(domain: context.domain)

              {acc ++ [copy], Map.put(map, m.id, copy.id)}
            end)

          copy_of_s = hd(new_messages)

          ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink
          |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
            kind: :fork_of,
            from_message_id: copy_of_s.id,
            to_message_id: source_message.id
          })
          |> Ash.create!(domain: context.domain)

          new_thread
        end)
    end
  end

  defp get_all_descendants(root, all_messages) do
    by_parent = Enum.group_by(all_messages, & &1.parent_id)
    [root | gather_children(root.id, by_parent)]
  end

  defp gather_children(parent_id, by_parent) do
    Enum.flat_map(Map.get(by_parent, parent_id, []), fn child ->
      [child | gather_children(child.id, by_parent)]
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.LinkedMessages do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship
  require Ash.Query

  def load(messages, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:linked_messages)

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    adj = Enum.group_by(all_links, & &1.from_message_id, & &1.to_message_id)
    message_map = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1})

    {:ok,
     Enum.map(messages, fn message ->
       bfs(message.id, adj, message_map)
     end)}
  end

  defp bfs(source_id, adj, message_map) do
    {dists, _} = bfs_loop(:queue.from_list([{source_id, 0}]), %{}, MapSet.new([source_id]), adj)

    dists
    |> Map.delete(source_id)
    |> Enum.map(fn {id, dist} ->
      message = Map.fetch!(message_map, id)
      {dist, message.position, message.id, message}
    end)
    |> Enum.sort()
    |> Enum.map(fn {_, _, _, message} -> message end)
  end

  defp bfs_loop(queue, dists, visited, adj) do
    case :queue.out(queue) do
      {:empty, _} -> {dists, visited}
      {{:value, {id, dist}}, q} ->
        neighbors = Map.get(adj, id, [])
        {q2, d2, v2} = Enum.reduce(neighbors, {q, dists, visited}, fn neighbor, {acc_q, acc_dists, acc_visited} ->
          if MapSet.member?(acc_visited, neighbor) do
            {acc_q, acc_dists, acc_visited}
          else
            { :queue.in({neighbor, dist + 1}, acc_q),
              Map.put(acc_dists, neighbor, dist + 1),
              MapSet.put(acc_visited, neighbor)
            }
          end
        end)
        bfs_loop(q2, d2, v2, adj)
    end
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements) || 0

    all_links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    endorsements =
      Enum.filter(all_links, &(&1.kind == :follow_up))
      |> Enum.frequencies_by(& &1.to_message_id)

    by_thread_id = Enum.into(all_messages, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.thread_id})
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    board_map = Enum.into(threads, %{}, &{&1.id, &1.board})

    all_messages_with_end =
      Enum.map(all_messages, fn m ->
        endors = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
        t_id = Map.get(by_thread_id, m.id)
        board = Map.get(board_map, t_id)
        {m, endors, board}
      end)

    # Apply filter
    filtered =
      Enum.filter(all_messages_with_end, fn {_m, endors, board} ->
        board in boards and endors >= min_endorsements
      end)

    # Apply the query's own filter on top
    filtered2 =
      Enum.filter(filtered, fn {m, _endors, _board} ->
        case Ash.Expr.eval(query.filter, record: m) do
          {:ok, result} -> result
          _ -> false
        end
      end)

    # Ordering
    sorted =
      case Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        true ->
          Enum.sort_by(filtered2, fn {m, endors, _} ->
            {-endors, m.position, m.id}
          end)

        false ->
          # Apply query sort at runtime
          results = Enum.map(filtered2, fn {m, _endors, _board} -> m end)

          sorted_records =
            Ash.Actions.Sort.runtime_sort(results, query.sort,
              domain: ThreadGraph.Forum,
              resource: ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
            )

          # Restore the endorsement tuples for metadata
          m_map = Enum.into(filtered2, %{}, &{elem(&1, 0).id, elem(&1, 1)})

          Enum.map(sorted_records, fn m ->
            {m, Map.fetch!(m_map, m.id), nil}
          end)
      end

    # Limit/offset
    limited =
      sorted
      |> Enum.drop(query.offset || 0)
      |> then(fn s ->
        case query.limit do
          nil -> s
          l -> Enum.take(s, l)
        end
      end)

    # Set metadata
    results =
      Enum.map(limited, fn {m, endors, _} ->
        Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, endors)
      end)

    {:ok, results}
  end
end
